title: 索引选择性与复合索引列序推导
expected_output:
=== 单列选择性 = distinct / 总行数 (越高越能过滤) ===
总行数 N = 1000000

列              distinct     选择性          平均每值行数
user_id        50000        0.050000     20.0
created_at     900000       0.900000     1.1
amount         200000       0.200000     5.0
status         5            0.000005     200000.0
is_deleted     2            0.000002     500000.0

=== 按选择性排序(等值查询的最优列序) ===
  1. created_at   选择性=0.900000
  2. amount       选择性=0.200000
  3. user_id      选择性=0.050000
  4. status       选择性=0.000005
  5. is_deleted   选择性=0.000002

=== 但列序不能只看选择性, 要看查询模式 ===
  查询: WHERE user_id=? AND status=? ORDER BY created_at
    -> 联合索引 (user_id, status, created_at)
       理由: 等值列按选择性从高到低, 排序/范围列放最后
  查询: WHERE status=? ORDER BY created_at
    -> 联合索引 (status, created_at)
       理由: 等值列按选择性从高到低, 排序/范围列放最后
code:
import math

N = 1000000
COLS = [
    ("user_id",    50000),
    ("created_at", 900000),
    ("amount",     200000),
    ("status",     5),
    ("is_deleted", 2),
]

print("=== 单列选择性 = distinct / 总行数 (越高越能过滤) ===")
print("总行数 N = %d" % N)
print()
print("%-14s %-12s %-12s %s" % ("列", "distinct", "选择性", "平均每值行数"))
for name, d in COLS:
    sel = d / N
    rows_per = N / d
    print("%-14s %-12d %-12.6f %.1f" % (name, d, sel, rows_per))

print()
print("=== 按选择性排序(等值查询的最优列序) ===")
order = sorted(COLS, key=lambda x: -x[1] / N)
for i, (name, d) in enumerate(order, 1):
    print("  %d. %-12s 选择性=%.6f" % (i, name, d / N))

print()
print("=== 但列序不能只看选择性, 要看查询模式 ===")
queries = [
    ("WHERE user_id=? AND status=? ORDER BY created_at",
     ["user_id", "status"]),
    ("WHERE status=? ORDER BY created_at",
     ["status"]),
]
for text, eqcols in queries:
    eqsorted = sorted(eqcols, key=lambda c: -dict(COLS)[c] / N)
    tail = "created_at" if "ORDER BY created_at" in text else ""
    cols = eqsorted + ([tail] if tail else [])
    print("  查询: %s" % text)
    print("    -> 联合索引 (%s)" % ", ".join(cols))
    print("       理由: 等值列按选择性从高到低, 排序/范围列放最后")
